<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/portal_sessions"}
#docs
Returns a SINGLE-USE entry credential (returned exactly once) and the /portal/s/&lt;token&gt; link the buyer opens to manage their payment methods. The org API key never reaches the buyer. The link is valid for ONE HOUR (`access_expires_at`) and is spent the first time it is opened — opening it exchanges the credential for a session held in an HttpOnly cookie, so do not persist or re-send the URL. `expires_at` is the ceiling on that session, not on the link.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link_kind` | `string` | no | How long the LINK stays openable. 'api' (default) lasts one hour and suits minting a link you immediately redirect an already-authenticated user to. 'email' lasts five days — use it when the link goes into a message a human reads later, because an hour expires before most people open their mail. Neither makes the link multi-use: it is spent on first open. Read `access_expires_at` for the actual deadline. One of `api`, `email`. |
| `redirect_url` | `string` | no | http(s). Where the buyer is sent after signing out of the portal. Omit to show the portal's own signed-out page. |
| `forward_url` | `string` | no | The portal page the link opens on. Omit to open `/portal` and let the portal pick its section. One of `/portal`, `/portal?tab=invoices`, `/portal?tab=plan`, `/portal?tab=methods`, `/portal?tab=details`. |
| `action` | `string` | no | Open the portal on one task. If the business turned the task off, the link opens the portal home. Do not send with forward_url. One of `pay_invoice`, `update_card`, `change_plan`, `cancel_subscription`. |
| `object` | `string` | no | The task's invoice (pay_invoice) or subscription (change_plan, cancel_subscription). It must belong to this customer. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `portal_session`. One of `portal_session`. |
| `id` | `string` | The portal session id. |
| `status` | `string` | Always `created` on a new session. |
| `token` | `string` | The bearer token for the portal link. We never store it, so save it now. |
| `url` | `string` | The portal link. Present only when the portal base URL is set. |
| `access_expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the link stops working for a first sign-in. |
| `expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The latest time the session can last. |
| `redirect_url` | `string` | Where the portal sends the customer when they leave. |
| `forward_url` | `string` | The portal page the link opens on. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Portal session (id, status, token, url?, access_expires_at, expires_at) |
| `400` | Invalid link_kind, redirect_url or forward_url |
| `404` | No such customer |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/portal_sessions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "link_kind": "api",
    "redirect_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing"
  }'
```
